Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

=== rip-relative and absolute references into another section
        .text
        leaq    msg(%rip), %rsi
        movl    $msg, %eax
        movabsq $msg, %rdx
        movq    msg(%rip), %rcx
        ret
        .data
        .space  0x100
msg:    .quad   1

=== calls into another section
        .text
entry:
        call    helper
        call    helper@PLT
        .section .text.helper, "ax"
helper:
        ret

=== data across sections
        .text
entry:
        ret
        .data
        .quad   entry
        .long   entry
        .long   entry - .
        .quad   entry - .
        .long   entry@PLT
